transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been having really scary hallucinations lately. I keep hearing voices and seeing things that other people tell me aren't actually there.

Have you also had times when you felt extremely high or unusually energetic, or very depressed, around the same time as the voices or visions? Or have the hallucinations happened when your mood felt normal too?

Yes, actually, both have happened. I often feel incredibly energetic and high at the exact same time that I'm hearing and seeing things. But there have also been periods, lasting for at least a couple of weeks, where the hallucinations kept happening even when my mood felt completely normal and stable.
During those high-energy times, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel full of energy, or do risky or impulsive things that were unusual for you?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed if I needed less sleep, and I don't think I've done anything particularly risky during those times.

When you felt unusually high or energetic, did that last for several days in a row, like at least 4 days or even a full week? During those times, did other people notice you were talking faster, acting differently, or seeming more driven than usual?

Oh, it lasted much longer than just a week—it actually went on for about seven months. During those times, people around me definitely noticed because I was acting completely different, constantly on the go, and extremely driven. It was really obvious to everyone.
Over the whole time you’ve been ill, have these high-energy or manic symptoms been present for most of the illness, or were they only there during a smaller part of the time?

Yes, those high-energy periods have definitely been present for most of the time I've been dealing with this. It feels like I've spent the majority of my illness in that state rather than it just being a small part of it.
Just to be clear, have there been at least 2 full weeks when the voices or visions were happening but you were not having that high, energized mood at all?

Yes, that's correct. There was definitely a period of at least two weeks where I was still seeing and hearing things, but my mood was completely normal. I didn't feel high or energized at all during those weeks.

Based on this conversation, Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features now seems unlikely because the patient reports at least 2 weeks of hallucinations occurring while mood was completely normal, which argues against psychosis being confined to mood episodes. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) is favored because there are prominent psychotic symptoms, a prolonged manic/high-energy syndrome, and mood symptoms have been present for most of the overall illness.
